title: VeSyMa Powertrain Library
subTitle: Optimization solution for powertrain multi-body dynamics from initial concept to detailed analysis
introduction: VeSyMA - Powertrain Dynamics Library is a Modelica-based library for modeling and simulating rotating multi-body systems such as automotive powertrains. This library is designed to efficiently build complex powertrain systems and broadly supports the entire development cycle, from rapid concept reviews using 1D simple models to precise dynamic analysis utilizing detailed multi-body models. Animation features are built into all components, allowing for an intuitive understanding of the system's dynamic behavior, and it provides seamless compatibility with other automotive libraries by complying with Modelica standard connectors.
